theorems.name: Submission.ts_fv_sum_inner_starProjection_eq_trace
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (P : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))) (L : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), ∑ k : Fin N, inner ℝ (L (P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ)))) (P.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ))) = LinearMap.trace ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) (L.toLinearMap ∘ₗ P.starProjection.toLinearMap)
